definitions.explanation: A technical drawing or diagram that shows the internal structure, framework, or organization of something. Used in engineering, architecture, science, and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構造図|こうぞうず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check the structural diagram of the building.

examples.japanese: {構造図|こうぞうず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかる。
examples.english: You can understand the internal mechanism by looking at the structural diagram.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構造図|こうぞうず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っていて→載る：27882_noru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The textbook has a structural diagram of a cell, with the role of each part explained.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧ (structure) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram, drawing). Applied broadly: in architecture and engineering it means a structural drawing of a building's framework; in science it means a diagram showing internal components; in business it can mean an organizational chart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {構造図|こうぞうず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to draw a structural diagram
- {構造図|こうぞうず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at a structural diagram
- {組織|そしき}{構造図|こうぞうず}: organizational structure chart
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{構造図|こうぞうず}: architectural structural drawing
